<thought>Only chlorine shows a clear M and M+2 peak with a ~4:1 intensity ratio, matching its natural isotopic distribution. No other element’s characteristic isotopic pattern (e.g., bromine’s ~1:1 M/M+2, sulfur’s small M+2, etc.) is evident. Therefore, chlorine is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['Cl']</final_answer>
